what_the_role_does: Record the idea, intended customer, expected value, assumptions and initial hypothesis.
done_gate_criteria: Idea is clearly stated as a testable business hypothesis.
loop_reentry_condition: If unclear, CEO revises the idea brief.

what_the_role_does: Assess strategic fit, potential differentiation, rough economics and feasibility.
done_gate_criteria: Company has a preliminary reason to investigate the opportunity.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to Step 01 if strategically irrelevant.

what_the_role_does: Convert the idea into a specific customer problem and desired outcome.
done_gate_criteria: Problem is specific, measurable and tied to a customer outcome.
loop_reentry_condition: If problem is vague, repeat discovery.

what_the_role_does: Define primary customer segment, use case, buying/user context and exclusions.
done_gate_criteria: A narrow, testable initial customer segment exists.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise ICP if research contradicts assumptions.

what_the_role_does: Interview/observe users and document current workflows, pain points and alternatives.
done_gate_criteria: Sufficient evidence exists to identify recurring pain points.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat interviews if evidence is weak or conflicting.

inputs: Research findings, market data, analytics where available
what_the_role_does: Estimate frequency, severity, affected users and measurable business impact.
done_gate_criteria: Opportunity is large enough or strategically important enough to test.
loop_reentry_condition: Stop or redefine if impact is insufficient.

what_the_role_does: Estimate TAM/SAM/SOM and relevant market trends.
done_gate_criteria: Market opportunity passes agreed threshold.
loop_reentry_condition: Reconsider segment if market is too small.

what_the_role_does: Map direct competitors, indirect alternatives, pricing, strengths, weaknesses and gaps.
done_gate_criteria: A credible differentiation opportunity is identified or hypothesis is revised.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to problem/ICP if no differentiated value is possible.

what_the_role_does: Use interviews, landing page, demos, pilots or pre-sales to test willingness to pay.
done_gate_criteria: Evidence supports a credible willingness-to-pay hypothesis.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat with revised value proposition/pricing if weak.

what_the_role_does: Express target customer, problem, solution, differentiated benefit and reason to believe.
done_gate_criteria: Message is understandable and differentiated to target users.
loop_reentry_condition: Test alternate positioning if unclear.

inputs: Value proposition, market research, pricing evidence
what_the_role_does: Choose revenue model, pricing structure, major cost drivers and monetization assumptions.
done_gate_criteria: Revenue model and key assumptions are explicit.
loop_reentry_condition: Iterate pricing/model if economics fail.

inputs: Pricing, CAC assumptions, AI/API costs, infrastructure assumptions
what_the_role_does: Model revenue per customer, gross margin, CAC, LTV and major variable costs.
done_gate_criteria: Economics have a plausible path to sustainable margins.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise pricing/product/channel assumptions.

inputs: Opportunity, market, validation, business model, unit economics
what_the_role_does: Challenge assumptions and decide whether to fund product discovery/build.
done_gate_criteria: Explicit decision, owner, budget and success criteria exist.
loop_reentry_condition: If No-Go, archive; if conditional, return to named step.

what_the_role_does: Define the product vision and intended long-term customer outcome.
done_gate_criteria: Vision is aligned with company strategy and customer problem.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise with CEO if strategic conflict exists.

inputs: Product vision, competitive analysis, business model
what_the_role_does: Define positioning, strategic choices, target segment, differentiation and strategic constraints.
done_gate_criteria: Strategy has clear choices and measurable objectives.
loop_reentry_condition: Revisit after new evidence.

what_the_role_does: Define activation, retention, conversion, revenue and product-value metrics.
done_gate_criteria: Metrics are measurable, instrumentable and tied to outcomes.
loop_reentry_condition: Refine metrics if they cannot drive decisions.

what_the_role_does: Map discovery, onboarding, core value action, retention, payment and advocacy.
done_gate_criteria: Critical user paths and value moments are identified.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to research if critical uncertainty remains.

supporting_roles: Designer; UX Researcher; AI/ML Engineer; Tech Lead
what_the_role_does: Generate multiple solution approaches rather than jumping to one feature set.
done_gate_criteria: Options are evaluated against value, feasibility and differentiation.
loop_reentry_condition: Generate alternatives if no viable option.

supporting_roles: CTO; AI/ML Engineer; Backend Engineer; Security
what_the_role_does: Prototype uncertain technical components, integrations, AI approaches and cost/latency assumptions.
done_gate_criteria: Major technical unknowns have evidence-based answers.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat spike for unresolved critical risks.

inputs: AI use cases, sample data, model/provider options
what_the_role_does: Test model quality, structured outputs, latency, safety, cost and failure modes.
done_gate_criteria: AI can meet minimum quality/cost thresholds or a non-AI fallback exists.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise AI approach or product scope.

what_the_role_does: Choose the smallest workflow that delivers the core customer value.
done_gate_criteria: Core value can be delivered without nonessential features.
loop_reentry_condition: Cut scope if MVP is too large.

supporting_roles: CPO; Tech Lead; Designer; QA; Growth
what_the_role_does: Define must-have, should-have, excluded and future capabilities.
done_gate_criteria: MVP has explicit boundaries and success criteria.
loop_reentry_condition: Reprioritize if scope exceeds budget/time.

supporting_roles: UX; Tech Lead; QA; AI/ML; Security
what_the_role_does: Document goals, personas, workflows, functional requirements, acceptance criteria and metrics.
done_gate_criteria: PRD is complete, testable and approved.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to discovery when requirements expose unknowns.

what_the_role_does: Specify events, properties, funnels, cohorts and reporting requirements.
done_gate_criteria: All critical product decisions can be measured.
loop_reentry_condition: Add events if gaps are found during testing.

what_the_role_does: Define navigation, content hierarchy and major screens.
done_gate_criteria: Critical journeys are represented with understandable navigation.
loop_reentry_condition: Iterate after usability testing.

what_the_role_does: Design low-fidelity screens and interactions.
done_gate_criteria: Flows cover happy paths and important edge cases.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise after usability findings.

what_the_role_does: Create clickable prototype and test with target users.
done_gate_criteria: Critical usability issues are resolved or consciously accepted.
loop_reentry_condition: Loop to wireframes if usability fails.

what_the_role_does: Produce implementation-ready visual design and reusable components.
done_gate_criteria: Screens, states, responsive behavior and components are specified.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise for technical/design issues.

supporting_roles: CTO; Backend; Frontend; AI; DevOps; Security
what_the_role_does: Define components, services, data flows, external dependencies and deployment model.
done_gate_criteria: Architecture covers requirements, risks and operational needs.
loop_reentry_condition: Rework if CTO/security/engineering identifies material risk.

what_the_role_does: Challenge architecture, scalability, cost, security and strategic fit.
done_gate_criteria: Architecture is approved or explicit changes are assigned.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to Step 29 until critical concerns are resolved.

what_the_role_does: Define entities, relationships, ownership, retention and access rules.
done_gate_criteria: Core data model supports MVP and governance needs.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise if requirements change.

what_the_role_does: Define endpoints, schemas, errors, auth and versioning.
done_gate_criteria: Contracts are implementable and testable.
loop_reentry_condition: Resolve ambiguities before implementation.

supporting_roles: Product; ML/AI Engineer; AI Evaluation; Security
inputs: AI feasibility report, PRD, data model
what_the_role_does: Specify inputs, outputs, model strategy, prompts, evaluation, guardrails, cost and fallback.
done_gate_criteria: AI behavior and quality thresholds are explicit.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise if evaluation/cost risk is unacceptable.

supporting_roles: CTO; Tech Lead; Legal; AI; Data
inputs: Architecture, data flows, AI spec, privacy requirements
what_the_role_does: Identify threats, sensitive data, access controls, retention and mitigation requirements.
done_gate_criteria: Critical security/privacy requirements are assigned and understood.
loop_reentry_condition: Rework architecture if critical risks cannot be mitigated.

what_the_role_does: Estimate people, engineering effort, infrastructure, AI/API and third-party costs.
done_gate_criteria: Estimate has assumptions, dependencies and confidence level.
loop_reentry_condition: Re-scope if budget/timeline fails.

supporting_roles: Engineering Manager; Tech Lead; QA; Designer
what_the_role_does: Break requirements into epics, stories, tasks and acceptance criteria; prioritize.
done_gate_criteria: Every MVP requirement maps to implementable work.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to PRD if work is ambiguous.

what_the_role_does: Sequence work, assign ownership, define milestones and release criteria.
done_gate_criteria: Plan has realistic scope, milestones and dependency management.
loop_reentry_condition: Replan if capacity changes.

inputs: MVP scope, delivery plan, cost, validation evidence
what_the_role_does: Approve resources and authorize development.
done_gate_criteria: Budget, team, scope and accountable owners are approved.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to planning if economics/scope fail.

what_the_role_does: Create repositories, environments, CI/CD, secrets management and baseline monitoring.
done_gate_criteria: Team can build/test/deploy safely with access controls.
loop_reentry_condition: Fix infrastructure blockers before development.

what_the_role_does: Implement services, authentication, core data access and foundational APIs.
done_gate_criteria: Core APIs work with automated tests and observability.
loop_reentry_condition: Fix defects and repeat implementation.

inputs: UI designs, API contracts, design system
what_the_role_does: Build navigation, auth, shared components and core screens.
done_gate_criteria: Core UI works against real/representative APIs.
loop_reentry_condition: Fix design/API issues and repeat.

supporting_roles: Head of AI; Backend; AI Evaluation; QA
what_the_role_does: Build prompts/model pipeline, structured outputs, retrieval/inference and telemetry.
done_gate_criteria: AI component meets initial evaluation thresholds and integrates with product.
loop_reentry_condition: Iterate model/prompt if evaluation fails.

what_the_role_does: Implement event collection, pipelines and data quality checks.
done_gate_criteria: Critical events are captured accurately and can be analyzed.
loop_reentry_condition: Fix missing/incorrect events.

what_the_role_does: Review architecture adherence, correctness, maintainability, performance and technical debt.
done_gate_criteria: Code meets engineering standards or exceptions are documented.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to engineer for required changes.

what_the_role_does: Review vulnerabilities, secrets, permissions, dependencies and security controls.
done_gate_criteria: No unresolved critical security issue blocks release.
loop_reentry_condition: Loop to engineering for remediation.

what_the_role_does: Run regression/quality/safety evaluations and classify failures.
done_gate_criteria: AI quality meets agreed thresholds for current scope.
loop_reentry_condition: Loop to AI engineering when thresholds fail.

inputs: PRD, acceptance criteria, architecture, AI spec
what_the_role_does: Define functional, integration, regression, API, performance, security and AI test coverage.
done_gate_criteria: Coverage and release criteria are explicit.
loop_reentry_condition: Expand plan when risk gaps appear.

what_the_role_does: Execute tests, automate critical paths, document defects and retest fixes.
done_gate_criteria: Acceptance criteria pass and critical defects are resolved/accepted.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to engineering until pass criteria are met.

what_the_role_does: Measure latency, throughput, failure recovery and resource behavior.
done_gate_criteria: Performance meets agreed thresholds or a conscious exception is approved.
loop_reentry_condition: Optimize/retest if thresholds fail.

what_the_role_does: Validate that the product solves the intended problem in realistic workflows.
done_gate_criteria: Core user outcome is achieved and blocking usability issues are resolved.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to Product/Design/Engineering as needed.

inputs: Product positioning, MVP capabilities, pricing, launch plan
what_the_role_does: Prepare messaging, website/store assets, sales enablement, FAQs and launch communications.
done_gate_criteria: All customer-facing teams have accurate messaging and materials.
loop_reentry_condition: Fix product/messaging gaps.

inputs: Unit economics, competitor pricing, validation evidence
what_the_role_does: Approve pricing, packages, discounts policy and financial assumptions.
done_gate_criteria: Pricing supports target economics and is operationally implementable.
loop_reentry_condition: Run additional pricing analysis/test.

inputs: Product docs, known issues, launch plan
what_the_role_does: Create onboarding, support workflows, knowledge base, escalation paths and SLAs.
done_gate_criteria: Support can resolve or correctly escalate expected issues.
loop_reentry_condition: Close readiness gaps.

supporting_roles: Tech Lead; Engineering Manager; QA; DevOps; Security; Product
inputs: Release candidate, test reports, monitoring, security assessment
what_the_role_does: Critically review technical quality, reliability, observability, rollback and operational readiness.
done_gate_criteria: All release blockers are resolved or explicitly accepted by authorized owners.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to engineering/QA.

inputs: Approved release candidate, deployment plan, rollback plan
what_the_role_does: Deploy using controlled CI/CD, monitor health and validate smoke tests.
done_gate_criteria: Release is stable and smoke tests pass.
loop_reentry_condition: Rollback and remediate if critical failure occurs.

what_the_role_does: Monitor activation, errors, conversion, user feedback and business KPIs.
done_gate_criteria: Initial launch objectives and critical issues are understood.
loop_reentry_condition: Escalate severe issues to Engineering/CS/CEO.

inputs: User accounts, onboarding playbook, product analytics
what_the_role_does: Guide users to first value and capture friction.
done_gate_criteria: Users reach activation milestone or churn reason is known.
loop_reentry_condition: Revise onboarding/product if activation is weak.

what_the_role_does: Capture feature requests, objections, outcomes, churn reasons and satisfaction.
done_gate_criteria: Feedback is categorized by frequency, impact and customer value.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat research for unresolved themes.

inputs: Analytics events, user behavior, billing data
what_the_role_does: Analyze acquisition-to-activation, activation-to-retention and payment funnel.
done_gate_criteria: Major drop-offs and opportunities are quantified.
loop_reentry_condition: Instrument missing data if necessary.

inputs: Revenue, acquisition spend, support costs, AI/API costs, usage
what_the_role_does: Calculate CAC, gross margin, contribution margin and early LTV signals.
done_gate_criteria: Economics are directionally understood and tracked over time.
loop_reentry_condition: Change pricing/channel/cost structure if economics fail.

what_the_role_does: Rank fixes and improvements by customer impact, business impact, risk and effort.
done_gate_criteria: Highest-value problems have owners and priorities.
loop_reentry_condition: Loop continuously while product is immature.

what_the_role_does: Implement changes, test, release and measure impact.
done_gate_criteria: Target metric or user problem improves, or hypothesis is rejected with evidence.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to discovery if changes do not solve root cause.

supporting_roles: CEO; Product Analytics; CS; Sales; Finance
inputs: Retention, repeat usage, referrals, qualitative feedback, revenue
what_the_role_does: Assess whether users consistently derive enough value to retain/pay/refer.
done_gate_criteria: Evidence supports or rejects PMF against predefined criteria.
loop_reentry_condition: Continue product iteration if PMF is not reached.

what_the_role_does: Select scalable channels and establish acquisition targets and budgets.
done_gate_criteria: At least one repeatable acquisition path has measurable economics.
loop_reentry_condition: Experiment with new channels.

inputs: Growth strategy, creative, landing pages, budget
what_the_role_does: Launch controlled acquisition experiments and optimize conversion.
done_gate_criteria: Experiments have measurable outcomes and learning.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat/kill/scale based on evidence.

inputs: Qualified pipeline, ICP, pricing, win/loss data
what_the_role_does: Standardize qualification, sales stages, forecasting, enablement and closing process.
done_gate_criteria: Pipeline coverage and conversion become predictable enough to forecast.
loop_reentry_condition: Refine ICP/message/process.

inputs: Customer health, churn data, onboarding results
what_the_role_does: Standardize lifecycle, health scoring, renewal and expansion playbooks.
done_gate_criteria: Retention risks are proactively managed and renewals/expansion are measurable.
loop_reentry_condition: Improve product/onboarding if churn drivers persist.

inputs: Usage data, model costs, latency, gross margin
what_the_role_does: Optimize models, caching, routing, infrastructure and workload efficiency.
done_gate_criteria: Unit costs improve without unacceptable quality degradation.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat as usage/cost changes.

inputs: Incident history, SLOs, security findings, growth forecast
what_the_role_does: Increase resilience, observability, capacity, security controls and disaster recovery.
done_gate_criteria: Critical reliability/security risks are controlled for target scale.
loop_reentry_condition: Reprioritize based on incidents/risk.

inputs: Growth plan, workload, bottlenecks, financial plan
what_the_role_does: Determine leadership layers, team boundaries, hiring sequence and operating cadence.
done_gate_criteria: Every critical capability has accountable ownership.
loop_reentry_condition: Reorganize if execution bottlenecks remain.

inputs: Approved hiring plan, role specs, budget
what_the_role_does: Recruit, assess, hire and onboard priority roles.
done_gate_criteria: Critical roles are filled and productive onboarding is complete.
loop_reentry_condition: Continue hiring based on capacity gaps.

what_the_role_does: Create weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews, decision logs, risk reviews and planning cycles.
done_gate_criteria: Performance and decisions are visible, owned and reviewed regularly.
loop_reentry_condition: Adjust cadence if it creates overhead without value.

supporting_roles: CEO; Product; Sales; Growth; Product Marketing
inputs: Usage, willingness-to-pay, margins, churn, competitive data
what_the_role_does: Test pricing/packaging and quantify impact on conversion, retention and margin.
done_gate_criteria: Pricing changes have evidence, owners and measured impact.
loop_reentry_condition: Run further experiments.

what_the_role_does: Manage budgets, margins, cash, headcount and investment allocation.
done_gate_criteria: Business has a credible path to target operating margin and cash sustainability.
loop_reentry_condition: Reduce cost/reallocate investment if targets miss.

inputs: PMF data, customer requests, market research
what_the_role_does: Evaluate adjacent segments using proven product capabilities and economics.
done_gate_criteria: Attractive segment has evidence of need, willingness to pay and strategic fit.
loop_reentry_condition: Reject or return to validation.

inputs: Expansion hypothesis, local market data, regulatory requirements
what_the_role_does: Research localization, competition, pricing, distribution and compliance.
done_gate_criteria: Entry thesis has evidence and identified risks.
loop_reentry_condition: Repeat research or reject market.

what_the_role_does: Define localization, new workflows, permissions, integrations and product changes.
done_gate_criteria: New segment requirements are explicit and prioritized.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to market validation if requirements undermine economics.

supporting_roles: Product; Design; AI; QA; DevOps; Security
what_the_role_does: Develop, test and release required capabilities.
done_gate_criteria: New segment can receive promised value reliably.
loop_reentry_condition: Iterate based on beta/launch results.

what_the_role_does: Develop channel/partner strategy, negotiate agreements and operationalize partner acquisition.
done_gate_criteria: Partners generate measurable qualified demand/revenue with acceptable economics.
loop_reentry_condition: Optimize or terminate underperforming partners.

supporting_roles: CPO; CTO; CFO; CMO; CRO; COO
inputs: Company performance, customer needs, adjacent opportunities
what_the_role_does: Decide whether to extend platform/product portfolio using capital allocation framework.
done_gate_criteria: Investment decision, owner, budget and success metrics are defined.
loop_reentry_condition: Return to opportunity discovery for selected concept.

inputs: Company dashboard, P&L, product metrics, market signals, risks
what_the_role_does: Review strategy, reallocate capital/people, kill weak initiatives and double down on winners.
done_gate_criteria: Resources are aligned to highest-value opportunities and risks.
loop_reentry_condition: This is a permanent loop back to strategy and operating execution.
